verdict.rationale: Atlas documents that it provides a registered agent for Delaware compliance (docs-7), but nothing in the evidence publishes a flat annual price or an up-front renewal price for that service. The $500 figure is the setup fee, and the "$300/yr" remark appears to be the SVB bank fee, not registered-agent pricing. A praise of Atlas for avoiding hidden registered-agent costs elsewhere (comm-10) is anecdotal and states no renewal price.
